summary: @servicetitan/unit-tests preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bytecode blob
details: The package's preinstall script setup.mjs (with hex-obfuscated identifiers and string-map wrappers) downloads bun-v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against the shipped 727 KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is a compiled-Bun CJS artifact (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, hex-named identifiers, string-array rotation) that is opaque to Node-based inspection. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bytecode payload at install time is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades ordinary source-level review. The package's ostensible functionality (dist/index.js is a trivial re-export of ts-mockito) is unrelated to the preinstall behavior. The `@servicetitan/unit-tests` name and `github.com/servicetitan/playground.git` repository position the package inside a company scope as cover for the install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
